name: Osmaniye

requests.outcome: Official TKGM page confirms Parsel Sorgu as the national public parcel service and documents province/district/neighborhood/parcel, coordinate, geometry display, and KML/PDF functions. It does not expose a bounded anonymous parcel response in the page content.
HTTP 200 HTML shell received (1,787 bytes). Current HTML loads main.js?v=76.3 and the public app configuration. No parcel result was returned by loading the shell directly.

HTTP 200 JavaScript received (4,250 bytes). The current app configuration was followed to https://cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/ and the app's public route structure; no credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or login was used.
HTTP 404 Not Found. API root is not a parcel response endpoint.
HTTP 404 JSON response: no HTTP resource matched the URI. This was a bounded exact-point probe using the immutable WUP point; it is not evidence of citywide absence.
HTTP 404 JSON response: no HTTP resource matched the URI. No province/neighborhood/parcel identifiers were invented, so no administrative parcel query was issued.
Official Osmaniye Municipality page received. It links Kent Rehberi at https://kentrehberi.osmaniye.bel.tr/ and E-İmar at https://kentrehberi.osmaniye-bld.gov.tr/.
Request timed out after 12 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript/configuration, API route, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry was obtained.

viewerInspection.details: TKGM current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and identifies the public MEGSIS API host. The municipal Kent Rehberi viewer was unreachable by bounded GET. No usable public map/API response was available for a retained sample.

schemaCrs.details: No parcel response was obtained; native field schema, CRS, geometry encoding, and stable native parcel identity could not be verified.

scopeLimits: TKGM is a national authority/service, not a city-specific registry custodian; official municipal links establish a local service custodian but not successful public parcel access.
The exact-point 404 and municipal timeout are service/request outcomes only and cannot establish citywide cadastral absence.
No map extent miss, login wall, timeout, or unusable UI is treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, transaction, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No native identity or geometry was retained, and no GeoJSON sample was created.
uncertainty: High: TKGM provides an official public parcel viewer, but its current API route contract was not recoverable from bounded anonymous probes; Osmaniye's municipal viewer also timed out. A real public or restricted source may still exist behind viewer interaction, route parameters, service availability, or authenticated access. Independent serial review is required before any adapter or source admission.
